reasoning: The question asks about the 1-week compounded euro short-term average rate (€STR) comparing Oct 18 vs Oct 11, 2026. Based on the evidence, the ECB raised rates in September 2026 to 2.50% deposit rate, effective Sept 16. The evidence strongly suggests rates will be held steady at the Oct 29 meeting (70/73 economists expect no change). With no rate changes expected between Oct 11-18, the 1-week compounded €STR should remain essentially stable, as it tracks overnight rates which follow the deposit rate. Without policy changes, day-to-day variations are minimal and roughly symmetric, making it approximately 50% likely to increase vs decrease.
